attempts_detail.primary_asr_text: Every morning, I look for an empty desk. Someone may have used it yesterday, and someone else may use it tomorrow. I cannot keep papers in a drawer. I sometimes worry about using a desk or keyboard after someone else. I spend time finding a place before work starts. I miss having the same desk, drawer, and view. They helped me start without looking around and gave me a quiet feeling that I belonged there. Now the office can feel like a place I only borrow. I want my work and things to have a place, even when I cannot choose the desk rules.

attempts_detail.primary_asr_text: Some mornings, I choose a quiet corner because I need to think. On other days, I sit where talking is easy. A different desk can put me near people from another department. It can also give me space when a work relationship feels uncomfortable. Sometimes I simply need room. Working from home gave me a place of my own, so I do not need one fixed place at the office. I like changing my surroundings. I choose a place that fits my mood and task. I also choose who is near me, or whether I want anyone near me.
